shots.summary: Closed red curtain. Spotlight sweeps, finds center. Marquee title letters MAISON BOULEDOGUE drop in one by one with thumps; subtitle 'Collection Grotesque'. Flashbulbs. Curtain whips open at the end (whip transition into S2).

Backstage chaos. Bulldog couturier screams at Pipette the mouse, who is on a ladder hammering the flamingo's absurd stiletto cage heels even higher (we see just the flamingo's legs and heels towering). Mouse deadpans. Bulldog's final line; he thrusts a pearl strand into the air.

Runway, side view. Flamingo struts in on 1-metre stiletto cages with a crystal chandelier hat. Strikes a pose at center -> flashbulb storm. Teeters dangerously (chandelier crystals swing wildly), recovers with a flamingo one-leg pose, exits right.

Giraffe enters wearing a pearl necklace coiled 40 times up her neck, cat-eye sunglasses, handbag hooked on an ossicone. Poses with a neck swoop -> flashes. SNAP: the strand breaks, hundreds of pearls explode and rain down, bouncing and rolling across the runway. Giraffe freezes, sunglasses slide down her nose.

Penguin in an umbrella-crinoline skirt waddles onto the pearl-covered runway, slips, slides fast, spins, flies off the end of the runway. Crowd gasps, music cuts to silence. The umbrella crinoline POPS open like a parasol and the penguin floats gracefully upward in the spotlight, veil fluttering. Silence... one clap... then uproar, confetti and music drop.

Bulldog steps out and takes a deep smug bow claiming it was intentional; Pipette beside him, winks at camera. Final title card MAISON BOULEDOGUE over the runway backdrop. Button: a single last pearl rolls toward camera and clinks against the lens.

dialogue.text: Mesdames, messieurs... and assorted mammals. Maison Bouledogue!
Pipette! The heels! Higher! Couture is pain!
Any higher, Monsieur, and she will need oxygen.
Then give her oxygen... in pearls!
Look two. Giraffe, in forty feet of pearls.
